Some learneds have designed the Shoola Dasha for determining the time of death. In this system, the Dasha commences from the 2nd or the 8th house whichever is stronger. If the sign be an odd one, the order of the Dasha of the signs will be onwards. It will be backwards in the case of an even sign. The Dasha years in this system are as adopted for the Sthira Dasha.
